test_title: SSC CPO Tier-II Previous Year Paper (Held On: 26th July 2021)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate one-word substitution for the given group of words.**

A fictitious name used by an author
solution: The correct answer is 'Pseudonym'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate meaning of the given group of words is 'pseudonym'. • Pseudonym: a name used by somebody, especially a writer, instead of his/her real name. (छद्मनाम, उपनाम; असली नाम के बदले प्रयुक्त, विशेषतः किसी लेखक द्वारा) • *Example: He writes estimable poetry under a **pseudonym**.* • Therefore, as per the points mentioned above, we find that the correct answer is Option 3. Correct Answer:__ *Pseudonym.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the meaning of other words given in the Options: **Words** **Meaning** **Homonym** a word that is spelt and pronounced like another word but that has a different meaning. (उच्‍चारण तथा वर्तनी में समान परंतु अर्थ में भिन्‍न शब्‍द; समनाम) **Namesake** a person who has the same name as another. (हमनाम, नामराशि; ऐसा व्यक्ति जिसका वही नाम हो जो दूसरे का है) **Alibi** a statement by somebody that says you were in a different place at the time of a crime and so cannot be guilty of the crime. (अपराध के समय अन्‍यत्र उपस्थित होने का कथन (यह सिद्ध करने के लिए की वह दोषी नहीं है); अन्‍यत्रता) d6:T1978, The correct answer is **The Principal said to Kamal, “How is it that you are always late for school?”**
